requirements.title: MIN argument restrictions
requirements.definition: All MIN arguments shall have the same type, that type shall be integer, real, or character, and all arguments shall have the same kind type parameter.

pending.MIN-arguments-same-type: Positive source controls call MIN with all-integer, all-real, and all-character arguments; source-control mutations mix integer with real or character and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MIN-arguments-integer-real-or-character: Positive source controls cover each admitted type category; a source-control mutation uses logical arguments and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MIN-arguments-same-kind: Positive source controls use same-kind arguments; a source-control mutation mixes two integer kinds and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MIN result type, kind, and character length
requirements.definition: The MIN result has the same type and kind as the arguments, and for character arguments its length is the length of the longest argument.

pending.MIN-result-same-type-and-kind: Evaluate MIN over integer and exact real arguments into sentinel variables and assert KIND(result)==KIND(argument) together with exact selected values; mutate one argument kind in source review so the kind check changes.
pending.MIN-character-result-longest-length: Evaluate MIN("A","A  ") into a character(len=3) variable prefilled with "###" and assert LEN(result)==3 and value "A  "; mutate the longer argument length so the length check changes.

requirements.title: MIN returns the smallest argument and pads shorter character results
requirements.definition: MIN returns the smallest argument, using intrinsic relational operators for character arguments and right-blank extension to the longest argument length for a selected shorter character argument.

pending.MIN-integer-smallest-exact: Evaluate MIN(-9,7,2) into an integer initialized to 777 and assert -9; mutate the negative operand to 9 so the selected value changes.
pending.MIN-real-smallest-exact: Evaluate MIN(-2.0,4.0,1.0) using exactly representable real operands and assert -2.0 after initializing the result to 99.0; mutate the first operand to 2.0 so the selected value changes.
pending.MIN-character-selected-by-relational-ope: Use default character values "A", "M", and "Z" with equal length, initialize the result to "#", and assert MIN("Z","M","A")=="A" with LEN equality; mutate the letter order or the intrinsic name to MAX so the guaranteed alphabetical default-character order is load-bearing.
pending.MIN-character-shorter-selected-blank-ext: Use default character arguments "A" and "Z  ", initialize a length-three result to "###", and assert LEN(result)==3 and result=="A  "; mutate the shorter argument to "Z" so the guaranteed alphabetical order and blank extension both remain load-bearing.
